recipe.name: guitar-slinger instrument 19: measured template audition
recipe.description: Existing approved waveform and quiet sustain, calibrated to the measured source root; recorded timbre and envelope are approximated.

pitch_calibration.method: Original instrument's first 8192 samples (or repeating loop), 8-fold interpolation, autocorrelation peak in the configured 29–35 sample period band; parabolic refinement.
pitch_calibration.scope: A monophonic triangle approximation. The recorded source has a different envelope and may have pitch drift.

measurement.evidence: Dominant near-sinusoidal root is about31.85 source samples in attack/body/loop. The63.69-sample repeat is an octave-low subharmonic and is not used.

analysis.tradeoff: Existing approved waveform and quiet sustain, calibrated to the measured source root; recorded timbre and envelope are approximated.

recipe.name: desert-dream-1 instrument 9: measured template audition
recipe.description: Existing approved pulse-arpeggio program renders the measured octave-spread chord as three successive tones. Simultaneous source tones, detuning and chorus are lost.

measurement.method: Hann-windowed source-loop spectral energy centroids; lowest salient root, fifth and octave-raised third. Strong octave/fifth harmonics are not counted as extra notes.
measurement.acf_caution: Long63/127-sample repetitions alone do not identify all chord tones; independent spectral groups determine the declared voicing.

analysis.tradeoff: Existing approved pulse-arpeggio program renders the measured octave-spread chord as three successive tones. Simultaneous source tones, detuning and chorus are lost.
